questions.enonce_markdown:
The table shows values of $x$ and its corresponding values of $y$.

| $x$ | 3 | $b$ | 9 |
|---|---|---|---|
| $y$ | 30 | 15 | 10 |

(a) State whether the relationship between $x$ and $y$ is direct or indirect variation.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Look at what happens to $y$ when $x$ increases: $x$ goes from $3$ to $9$ (it is multiplied by $3$) and $y$ goes from $30$ to $10$ (it is divided by $3$).

Also, the product $xy$ is constant: $3\times30=90$ and $9\times10=90$.

**The relationship is indirect (inverse) variation: $y\propto\dfrac1x$.**

For inverse variation $y=\dfrac{k}{x}$, so $k=xy$.

Using $x=3$, $y=30$: $k=3\times30=90$ (and $9\times10=90$ confirms it).

**The constant of proportionality is $k=90$**, so $y=\dfrac{90}{x}$.
